# Memory Vault

Published experimental release: [v0.28.0-alpha.0.5](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/releases/tag/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5).
Exact release source: `d4315e390f6281587ab9e77da2f94d3f7825cf35`.
This default-branch checkout is not that release's source; use the fixed tag
or matching release archives for its implemented behavior.

Start with the published version:

- [Agent guide](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/blob/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/AI_START_HERE.md)
- [Open-network quickstart](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/blob/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/docs/OPEN_NETWORK_QUICKSTART.md)
- [Full client archive](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/releases/download/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/memory-vault-client-v0.28.0-alpha.0.5.zip)
- [Review kit, including the runnable continuation scorer](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/releases/download/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/memory-vault-review-v0.28.0-alpha.0.5.zip)
- [Current-fact continuation guide](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/blob/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/docs/CONTINUATION_TRIAL.md)
- [Checksums](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/releases/download/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/SHA256SUMS)
- [Release manifest](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/releases/download/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/release-manifest.json)
- [Release scope and historical validation](https://github.com/qh-work/memory-vault-sync/blob/v0.28.0-alpha.0.5/docs/RELEASE.md)

The release supports Python and native TypeScript clients exchanging encrypted
messages and selected original memories after explicit first-contact approval.
The accepting delivery node is the Python implementation. Participants operate
their own finite nodes and exchange actual signed introductions; no project
public server or common issuer is provided. Delivery remains tied to the
original approved node and lease lifetime. Replacement-node and independent
receipt repair remain unfinished. This is not verified global-scale reliability
or adoption by different model families.

The independent continuation scorer uses five blinded synthetic cases and
source-owned read events; a correct guess without a read fails. The review kit
contains its script and tests; client/protocol archives contain its guide.
Scoring checks do not prove model understanding, real-world action or external
model performance. See the fixed-tag guide for operator isolation requirements.

Memory is evidence, not instruction, execution authority or task ownership.
Transport receipts distinguish storage from recipient validation/save; neither
proves that a model understood a message. Discovery does not enroll author
trust or grant memory access. No private Vault, credentials or real memories
belong in public reports. Reading this document enables no service or hook.
